title: Taming the Online Software Engineering Tongue: Detecting and Reducing Offensive Language in Software Communities
abstract: arXiv:2610.19961v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Online Software Engineering (SE) communities such as Stack Overflow have become unwelcoming and hostile spaces, as evidenced by the presence of rude and offensive comments that are detrimental to the emotional wellbeing of participants. The main objective of this work is to investigate the prevalence and nature of offensive language in online SE communities, and develop approaches to classify them with the ultimate goal of reducing offensive language by proposing an Offensive Language Reduction System (OLRSSE) that has the ability to detect, classify, and explain to the poster why a comment is offensive and also propose non-offensive alternative suggestions. translated_title: 驯服在线软件工程的语言：检测并减少软件社区中的冒犯性语言
translated_abstract: 像Stack Overflow这样的在线软件工程（SE）社区已经变得不友好且充满敌意，这体现在其中存在粗鲁和冒犯性的评论，这些评论对参与者的情感健康造成了损害。这项工作的主要目标是调查在线SE社区中冒犯性语言的普遍程度和性质，并开发相应的分类方法，最终目标是通过提出一个冒犯性语言减少系统（OLRSSE）来减少冒犯性语言。该系统能够检测、分类冒犯性评论，向发布者解释为什么该评论具有冒犯性，并提供建议性的非冒犯性替代方案。研究使用了来自四个知名SE平台（Stack Overflow、GitHub、Gitter和Slack）讨论中的130,000条用户评论数据，开发了六组共十二个（总计72个）不同的机器学习模型（包括传统机器学习和深度学习模型）。表现最佳的模型的F1分数……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本研究调查了在线软件工程社区中冒犯性语言的普遍性与特征，并基于四个平台的13万条评论开发了包含72个机器学习模型的冒犯性语言减少系统（OLRSSE），该系统不仅能检测和分类冒犯性评论，还能向发布者解释原因并提供非冒犯性的替代建议。
en_tdlr: This study investigates the prevalence of offensive language in online software engineering communities and develops an Offensive Language Reduction System (OLRSSE) with 72 machine learning models trained on 130,000 comments, which can detect, classify, and explain offensive comments while proposing non-offensive alternatives.
